lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Choose a Collector-managed vector whose project item is editable, generic mobile is_editable is false and synchronization direction is both
Open layer properties, visit Synchronization, Fields and General, then leave without changing anything
Reopen properties and verify the direction is still both and the layer remains available for creating or editing objects
Select server-to-device only, close and reopen properties, then return the same layer to both directions
value.expected: A no-op settings visit never mutates the stored direction; the Collector owning policy keeps the direction control available independently of generic is_editable, and an accidentally server-only layer becomes editable again after selecting both without deleting or reimporting it.
